title: General settings
description: The app's general settings file (settings/settings.json in the app data folder).

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code: the name of a file in src/locales (for example 'en' or 'he'). English until changed.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: 'system' follows the operating system's light/dark setting and switches with it. Otherwise the id of a built-in ('dark', 'light') or custom theme. Starts as 'system'; choosing a theme saves its id here.

open.title: Open
open.description: The panel is shown (true) or hidden (false).

side.title: Side
side.description: Window edge the panel sits on. Starts as the language's default side.

pauseVideoInBackground.title: Pause video in the background
pauseVideoInBackground.description: When the window is not in front and the video has a separate audio file, the picture pauses and only the audio plays (saves resources). The video continues from the audio's position when the window comes back. Videos without a separate audio file are not affected.

downloads.title: YouTube downloads
downloads.description: Defaults for downloading from YouTube. The quality dialog opens with these selected.

mode.title: Download as
mode.description: 'together' = one file with picture and sound (YouTube offers this only up to about 720p); 'separate' = a video file and an audio file (best quality; the player plays them together); 'audioOnly' = only the audio.

videoQuality.title: Video quality
videoQuality.description: Highest picture height in pixels. A video that lacks it uses the closest quality.

audioQuality.title: Audio quality
audioQuality.description: 'medium' is about 128 kbit/s and 'low' about 64 kbit/s.

folder.title: Download folder
folder.description: Where downloaded files are saved. Empty = the system's Videos folder.

delayBetweenVideos.title: Pause between videos
delayBetweenVideos.description: Seconds to wait after a video is finished before the next one starts (0 = no pause).

speedLimitKbps.title: Speed limit
speedLimitKbps.description: Maximum download speed in KiB per second (0 = unlimited).

autoResume.title: Continue after restart
autoResume.description: Downloads that were unfinished when the app was closed continue when it starts again.

cookiesBrowser.title: Use YouTube sign-in from browser
cookiesBrowser.description: Needed for age-restricted videos and when YouTube asks to confirm that you are not a robot. Empty = do not use a browser.
